planets.Sun: Represents the soul, ego, vitality, authority, and father. It dictates one's core identity and sense of purpose. In Aries, it is exalted (strong leadership); in Libra, it is debilitated (struggles with self-assertion).
planets.Moon: Represents the mind, emotions, maternal instincts, intuition, and peace of mind. It dictates how one responds emotionally to life. In Taurus, it is exalted (emotional stability); in Scorpio, it is debilitated (intense, turbulent emotions).
planets.Mercury: Represents intellect, communication, logic, analytical skills, commerce, and writing. In Virgo, it is exalted (extreme attention to detail); in Pisces, it is debilitated (more intuitive, less logical).
planets.Venus: Represents love, relationships, aesthetics, luxury, art, and harmony. It governs how we connect with others and seek pleasure. In Pisces, it is exalted (unconditional love); in Virgo, it is debilitated (overly critical in relationships).
planets.Mars: Represents energy, passion, action, courage, ambition, and aggression. It governs our drive and physical vitality. In Capricorn, it is exalted (controlled, structured energy); in Cancer, it is debilitated (passive-aggressive or emotional anger).
planets.Jupiter: Represents wisdom, philosophy, expansion, luck, spirituality, and higher learning. It is the great benefic. In Cancer, it is exalted (nourishing wisdom); in Capricorn, it is debilitated (struggles with optimism).
planets.Saturn: Represents discipline, structure, delay, karma, limitations, and hard work. It teaches perseverance through challenge. In Libra, it is exalted (balanced justice); in Aries, it is debilitated (impatience under restriction).
planets.Rahu: The North Node of the Moon. Represents worldly desires, ambition, obsession, innovation, and unconventional ideas. It creates a drive to achieve in the house it occupies, but can lead to illusion.
planets.Ketu: The South Node of the Moon. Represents spirituality, detachment, liberation (moksha), introspection, and past-life talents. It creates a feeling of separation or mastery in the house it occupies.

houses.1st: The Ascendant (Lagna). Represents the physical body, self, personality, general health, life path, and first impressions.
houses.2nd: Represents accumulated wealth, family, speech, food habits, values, and facial features.
houses.3rd: Represents courage, younger siblings, short travels, communication, writing, manual skills, and self-effort.
houses.4th: Represents home, mother, emotional security, happiness, vehicles, real estate, and inner peace.
houses.5th: Represents creativity, intelligence, children, romance, ancient wisdom, speculative gains, and self-expression.
houses.6th: Represents daily routines, health, debts, obstacles, enemies, service, and overcoming challenges.
houses.7th: Represents spouse, marriage, business partnerships, legal agreements, and public relations.
houses.8th: Represents longevity, transformation, secrets, research, occult sciences, inheritance, and unexpected changes.
houses.9th: Represents luck, higher education, father, religion, spirituality, long-distance travel, and philosophy.
houses.10th: Represents career, reputation, public life, authority, achievements, and social status.
houses.11th: Represents gains, elder siblings, social networks, friendships, hopes, and fulfillment of desires.
houses.12th: Represents isolation, expenses, foreign travel, subconscious mind, spiritual liberation, sleep, and dreams.

signs.Aries: Element: Fire. Ruler: Mars. Characteristics: Energetic, pioneering, assertive, courageous, impulsive.
signs.Taurus: Element: Earth. Ruler: Venus. Characteristics: Stable, practical, sensual, patient, stubborn.
signs.Gemini: Element: Air. Ruler: Mercury. Characteristics: Versatile, curious, intellectual, communicative, restless.
signs.Cancer: Element: Water. Ruler: Moon. Characteristics: Nurturing, emotional, intuitive, protective, moody.
signs.Leo: Element: Fire. Ruler: Sun. Characteristics: Creative, generous, proud, dramatic, warm-hearted.
signs.Virgo: Element: Earth. Ruler: Mercury. Characteristics: Analytical, meticulous, practical, helpful, critical.
signs.Libra: Element: Air. Ruler: Venus. Characteristics: Diplomatic, artistic, social, fair-minded, indecisive.
signs.Scorpio: Element: Water. Ruler: Mars/Pluto. Characteristics: Intense, passionate, secretive, powerful, transformational.
signs.Sagittarius: Element: Fire. Ruler: Jupiter. Characteristics: Optimistic, philosophical, adventurous, generous, impatient.
signs.Capricorn: Element: Earth. Ruler: Saturn. Characteristics: Disciplined, ambitious, practical, patient, reserved.
signs.Aquarius: Element: Air. Ruler: Saturn/Uranus. Characteristics: Humanitarian, innovative, independent, friendly, rebellious.
signs.Pisces: Element: Water. Ruler: Jupiter/Neptune. Characteristics: Compassionate, artistic, intuitive, spiritual, dreamy.
